clue.text: Abigail's card game

parts.note: an abigail is an old word for a lady's maid, so the game named for her is the one where the unpaired queen is left over

explanation.definitionFit: A children's card game in which the player left holding the unmatched queen loses, and an abigail is a maid.

clue.text: Pedestrian winger would love a way to get wealthy

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O
ST abbreviates street, a way
rich means wealthy

explanation.surface: A walker with wings dreams of getting rich.
explanation.definitionFit: A flightless bird that runs rather than flies, so a winged creature on foot.

clue.text: The hopelessness that figures largely in "pilgrim's progress"

definitions.text: The hopelessness that figures largely in "pilgrim's progress"

parts.words: The hopelessness that figures largely in "pilgrim's progress"
parts.note: a loss of hope personified in Bunyan's allegory as a giant who imprisons the pilgrim

explanation.definitionFit: Total loss of hope, embodied as Giant Despair of Doubting Castle in Bunyan's allegory The Pilgrim's Progress.

clue.text: French friend to leave when Spanish pal arrives

parts.note: ami is French for friend
to go is to leave

explanation.surface: A French friend departs as a Spanish companion turns up.
explanation.definitionFit: Amigo is Spanish for friend.

clue.text: Short-term work sir robin found with party

parts.note: Sir Robin Day was a famous British television political interviewer
Labour is a UK political party

explanation.surface: A broadcaster takes on casual work for a political party.
explanation.definitionFit: Work hired and paid by the day, a short-term casual job.

clue.text: Sexy devil!

parts.note: read literally, a demon that visits sleepers for sex, not a flirtatious compliment

explanation.walkthrough: The exclamation looks like a cheeky compliment to an attractive person; taken literally it describes a male demon of legend.
explanation.definitionFit: A demon of folklore said to lie with sleeping women, literally a devil concerned with sex.

clue.text: In a state when detective enters

indicators.note: enters says the detective goes inside the words in a

parts.note: taken as written
DI abbreviates Detective Inspector

explanation.surface: Someone is agitated when the police inspector arrives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In a state' reads as being upset; 'state' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A country of south Asia, a nation or state.

clue.text: A case to be discharged

parts.note: not a legal case dismissed by a court but a casing holding a charge that is fired

explanation.definitionFit: The casing holding powder and bullet for a gun, which is fired.

clue.text: Financiers — like Thames & Hudson?

definitions.meaning: rivers, which have banks, treated as things with banks

explanation.surface: Money men compared with a famous publishing house.
explanation.walkthrough: Thames & Hudson is a London publisher, but here the Thames and the Hudson are rivers, each with banks.
explanation.definitionFit: Both money managers and, whimsically, rivers, since rivers have banks.

clue.text: She's taking half Kelvin's foreign money

indicators.note: taking means the woman's word holds the following piece

parts.note: she plus s taken as written

indicators.note: half means the first three letters of Kelvin

explanation.surface: A woman pockets part of Kelvin's foreign cash.
explanation.definitionFit: The shekel is the currency of Israel, so foreign money to a British solver.

clue.text: Give evidence at trial if you first appear

parts.note: a trial is a test

indicators.note: first means only the opening letter of the word you is used

explanation.surface: A court tells a witness to give evidence once they turn up at the trial.
explanation.definitionFit: To swear to facts as a witness in court is to give evidence.

clue.text: Drive mad when they cause confusion?

definitions.meaning: to throw things into disorder, as a verb

explanation.surface: Things that cause confusion can drive a person mad.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to make insane and to disarrange or throw into disorder.

clue.text: A tan Moira badly wanted — she has a lover!

indicators.note: badly signals that the letters of a tan Moira are jumbled

explanation.surface: A tanned woman called Moira is desperate for romance and has found a boyfriend.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian-derived word for a woman who is loved, a sweetheart in a romantic pairing.

clue.text: Old magistrate seeing "all about Eve"?

parts.note: re is a short word for about or concerning
the name taken as written

explanation.surface: An elderly judge goes to watch the film All About Eve.
explanation.walkthrough: The quoted film title All About Eve tempts a whole-phrase reading; only 'about' and 'Eve' give letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A medieval English official, a chief officer of a town or district who kept the peace.

clue.text: A mount that might be chestnut

definitions.text: A mount that might be chestnut

parts.words: A mount that might be chestnut
parts.note: a riding animal whose coat colour can be a reddish brown, not a tree or a roasting nut

explanation.definitionFit: Chestnut is a reddish-brown coat colour of this riding animal, which is a rider's mount.

clue.text: Contrives to get Niger seen differently

indicators.note: differently says the letters of Niger seen are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone plots to make Niger viewed in a new light.
explanation.definitionFit: To engineer something is to contrive or arrange it.

clue.text: Goes ott with second injection?

parts.note: over the top as in going too far with medicine, and a further shot read as another dose

explanation.definitionFit: Taking too much of a drug, with a second jab treated as one dose too many.

clue.text: Avoids taking a look at cuts of meat

indicators.note: taking means the avoiding word holds the look inside it

parts.note: escapes means avoids
lo is an old word meaning look

explanation.surface: Someone dodges glancing at the butcher's cuts.
explanation.definitionFit: An escalope is a thin boneless slice of meat, often veal.

clue.text: Positive cat is to go in Eric's custody

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: in with custody says the word go is held inside the name Eric

parts.note: the name taken as written
go taken as written

explanation.surface: A cat is placed in Eric's care, and that is definite.
explanation.definitionFit: Categoric statements are absolute and unqualified, so definite or positive.

clue.text: In helicopter it's cold — jumper needed

parts.note: C abbreviates cold on taps
a hopper is something that jumps

explanation.surface: It is chilly in the helicopter, so a sweater is needed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jumper' suggests a British sweater; here it is something that hops.
explanation.definitionFit: Chopper is informal for a helicopter.

clue.text: Marigold can get in the back seat

indicators.note: in says get is placed inside the turned seat
back says the word seat is read the other way

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A marigold can be put in the back of a car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the back seat' looks like a car's rear seat; 'back' instead turns the word seat round, and 'in' sets the other word inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Tagetes is the genus name of the French and African marigolds.

clue.text: Soil the planet thus

definitions.meaning: ground or dirt in which plants grow

explanation.surface: Polluting our world in just this way.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both garden dirt and our home world, third from the Sun.

clue.text: Woman gets out of bed for cheese

indicators.note: gets out of read as gets outside of, so the name surrounds the bed

parts.note: Rita is a woman's name
a cot is a small bed

explanation.surface: A woman rises from bed to fetch some cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets out of' looks like rising from bed; read it as getting around the outside, so the woman's name wraps the bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Ricotta is a soft Italian whey cheese.

clue.text: Greek underworld take over east Nebraska

parts.note: hell is the underworld
NE is the US postal abbreviation for Nebraska

explanation.surface: Hades takes over the eastern part of a US state.
explanation.definitionFit: A Hellene is a Greek, from Hellas, the Greek name for Greece.

clue.text: An ear, perhaps, for music played on this

definitions.meaning: a body part with a function, the ear being an example
a keyboard instrument with pipes, played in churches

explanation.surface: Having an ear for music helps when playing this.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a body part such as the ear and a large pipe instrument heard in church.

clue.text: Controversial European claim is out of order

parts.note: a Pole is a European from Poland

indicators.note: out of order says the letters of claim are rearranged

explanation.surface: A European's assertion is ruled out of order as contentious.
explanation.definitionFit: Polemical writing is argumentative and attacks a view, so it stirs controversy.

clue.text: Courses for pathans without an employment

indicators.note: without says the letters of an are removed from pathans

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Routes laid out for Pashtun people lacking a job.
explanation.walkthrough: Pathans are Pashtun people of Afghanistan and Pakistan.
explanation.definitionFit: Paths are routes or courses taken.

clue.text: 100 from Rome came, touring holy place

indicators.note: touring suggests the letters wander round into a new order

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: A hundred came from Rome on a pilgrimage tour.
explanation.definitionFit: Mecca is the holiest city of Islam, a place of pilgrimage.

clue.text: It's obvious I also needed to be long-suffering

indicators.note: needed says the letter I is required inside the word for obvious

parts.note: patent means plain or evident

explanation.surface: It is plain that tolerance is required here as well.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone patient endures delay or trouble calmly, the same as being long-suffering.

clue.text: Loop to attach early English carnation

parts.note: a picot is a small ornamental loop on lace edging
EE abbreviates Early English, the architectural style

explanation.surface: A gardener ties an old English variety of carnation with a loop.
explanation.definitionFit: A picotee is a variety of carnation whose pale petals have a darker edge.

clue.text: Refuses sister's cooking

indicators.note: cooking suggests the letters of sister's are mixed and worked over

explanation.surface: Someone declines to eat a sibling's food.
explanation.definitionFit: To resist is to refuse to give way or accept something.

clue.text: A wise man, if getting pale and sickly, goes to Dorset resort

indicators.note: getting here means the wise man takes in the word for pale

parts.note: a sage is a wise man
wan means pale and unwell

explanation.surface: An ailing wise man heads to the seaside for his health.
explanation.definitionFit: Swanage is a seaside town on the Isle of Purbeck in Dorset, a county in south-west England.
